glossary.definition: (3) In accordance with 21 C.F.R. 201.125, the dangerous drug shall not be used for a clinical use. "Clinical use" includes the drug being furnished to a human or animal with the intent or understanding that the human or animal will ingest or otherwise absorb the drug into the human's or animal's body.
